fields.title: 📖 Whoever cannot manage the end of the night
fields.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh b. Aḥmad asked his father, Imām Aḥmad**, whether he preferred the **Witr prayer** at the beginning of the night or at the end.

***“As for me, I pray Witr at the beginning. But whoever is strong enough to pray it at the end of the night, there is no problem in that.”***

Then he asked him about someone who fears falling asleep. **Imām Aḥmad said:**

***“He prays Witr at the beginning of the night.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Ahlus-Sunnah** do not act by wishful thinking, but by the **Sunnah, caution, and honest knowledge of one’s own weakness**.
